extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities using ratio language.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate associated with a ratio in which the second quantity is one.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Ratios
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratios that describe the same relationship and can be shown in tables.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship between two quantities whose ratios are equivalent.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant unit rate in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be written as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that is not rational.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A base-ten representation of a number, including rational numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A line used to represent and compare numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical phrase involving numbers, operations, and variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A letter that stands for a number in an expression.

extracted_concepts.name: Integer Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent that is an integer, used in powers.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement that two expressions are equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement that compares expressions using > or <.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation that represents a linear relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A plane used to draw points and polygons from coordinates.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A closed two-dimensional figure with straight sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A round plane figure with area and circumference formulas.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of the region inside a two-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of space occupied by a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Surface Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The total area of the surfaces of a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Net
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional layout representing a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A theorem relating the side lengths of a right triangle.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data.

extracted_concepts.name: Data Set
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A collection of numerical data considered in context.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of center found by averaging data.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of center that is the middle value of data.

extracted_concepts.name: Interquartile Range
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of variability of the middle half of data.

extracted_concepts.name: Random Sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method used to draw inferences about a population.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule assigning each input exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose graph is a straight line, y = mx + b.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of a line, interpreted from unit rate.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Triangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Triangles with the same shape used to explain constant slope.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph for bivariate measurement data showing patterns.
